versions.changelog: The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

store-new-item-launch 0.1.1

- Adds clear planning and structure for generating new-item still sets and boards for store launches.
- Outlines strict input requirements and fact handling; avoids fabricating product details.
- Specifies workflow for generating, confirming, and billing for three initial stills, with separate flow for follow-up packs.
- Details technical execution via designated scripts and remote calls, bypassing direct connector or REST API access.
- Clarifies review, delivery, and error/recovery process for generated assets.
